section_name: Systematic Prediction Offsets and Residual Interpretation

candidates.title: The Examination and Analysis of Residuals
candidates.reason: Foundational paper in regression diagnostics that formalizes residual inspection to detect systematic additive discrepancies, baseline level shifts, and structural model inadequacies in linear predictors.

candidates.title: A General Definition of Residuals
candidates.reason: Seminal work formalizing the mathematical definition and behavior of residuals across linear and generalized models, providing theoretical justification for interpreting residuals as deviations from fixed or unadjusted predictors.

candidates.title: The Analysis of Disturbances in Regression Analysis
candidates.reason: Classic econometric text examining algebraic properties of regression residuals, showing how unmodeled constant terms manifest as systematic additive biases across sample observations.

candidates.title: Generalized Linear Models
candidates.reason: Foundational review paper establishing the formal framework for linear predictors and fixed additive offsets, distinguishing estimated parameters from pre-specified additive corrections.

candidates.title: Graphs in Statistical Analysis
candidates.reason: Seminal instructional paper showing that aggregate summary statistics can conceal uniform systematic offsets, illustrating the necessity of direct residual examination on finite instructional samples.

candidates.title: Science and Statistics
candidates.reason: Influential philosophical survey on statistical modeling and residual-based diagnostic criticism, emphasizing that simple linear approximations and residual corrections serve pedagogical and diagnostic roles rather than claims of universal truth.

candidates.title: Regression Diagnostics: Identifying Influential Data and Sources of Collinearity
candidates.reason: Foundational reference on linear regression diagnostics, detailing how omitted intercepts or constant offsets in predictors generate persistent non-zero mean residuals.

candidates.title: Residuals and Influence in Regression
candidates.reason: Comprehensive landmark monograph dedicated to residual interpretation, outlining how sample mean residuals reflect uncaptured constant offsets and distinguishing in-sample calibration from model evaluation.

candidates.title: Estimating the Error Rate of a Prediction Rule: Improvement on Cross-Validation
candidates.reason: Pivotal paper delineating the conceptual boundary between in-sample fitting error and out-of-sample evaluation, directly supporting the instructional distinction between sample-level residual subtraction and general prediction.

candidates.title: Generalized Additive Models
candidates.reason: Foundational treatise on additive model structures and partial residual interpretation, illustrating how constant additive offsets isolate baseline discrepancies in predictor functions.

candidates.title: Statistical Modeling: The Two Cultures
candidates.reason: Influential survey discussing the operational differences between fitting predictors to observed finite datasets and evaluating generalizable predictive accuracy.

candidates.title: Models as Approximations I: Consequences Illustrated with Linear Regression
candidates.reason: Authoritative review paper exploring assumption-lean regression, treating fixed linear predictors as approximations and explaining how finite-sample residual corrections relate to target data-generating offsets.
